status: Exploratory fit design frozen after identity/host/redshift and release-semantics inspection, before any new YSE brightness fit.
sample: 66 exact-name normal-Ia candidates with SN positions within1arcsec, compatible published spectroscopic redshift, p(host)>=.9, YSE/FrankenBlast host centroids within1arcsec, host spectroscopic redshift .01–.25. All candidate failures are retained.
fit: Native sncosmo SALT3 using existing frozen DES5YR surface and public PS1griz+ZTFgr bandpasses. Redshift fixed to host spectroscopic value; F99Rv3.1 foreground using YSE MWEBV. Fit t0,x0,x1,c with no per-epoch detection cut beyond the released data. Provisional Gaussian fit identifies a fixed rest-phase−10to40window; fit primary positive-flux-truncated Gaussian likelihood and ordinary Gaussian sensitivity on the same epochs.
truncation: Account explicitly for released f>0 via logPhi(model_flux/error) in negative log likelihood. MAGERR<=1.5 selection cannot be reconstructed from flux/error: observed MAGERR is not exactly1.0857/SNR. Other quality, event, follow-up and host selection also remain unnormalized. Positive truncation alone is not full selection correction.
analysis_gates: Converged positive covariance; no fitted numerical boundary; |x1|<3,|c|<.3, sigma_x1<1,sigma_c<.1; at least one epoch before rest-phase0, one after10, two bands withSNR>=5; at least10 retained epochs. Common Gaussian/truncated cohort for paired comparison.
brightness: Free normalization and jointly fit alpha,beta with full SALT mB/x1/c covariance. Fixed-reference distance law and redshift-stratum intercepts isolate conditional within-stratum association. Integrate same-row joint host age/formedmass/stellarAv draws under unchanged author training population; never call this a prior-free age likelihood. No independent prior from overlapping SN rows.
uncertainty: Condition on supplied epoch errors, model surface and passbands; missing template/calibration covariance and selection remain limitations. Peculiarvelocity300km/s working scatter with150/500 sensitivity; no assumption that released .005placeholder is actual hostspec precision.
validation: Independent objective/sign and optimizer checks, Gaussian zero-truncation limit, covariance Jacobian, all failures counted. Host folds if sample supports held-out prediction; lack of support is reported rather than filled by a simulation.
